title: 2D concept image
description: Exploration image for a character, prop or environment; feeds art2d concept artifacts.

guidance: Describe subject, mood, silhouette and key shapes before details.
Name camera framing (full body, three-quarter, wide establishing).
Keep one focal subject; the background supports it.

prompt_rubric: The prompt names one clear subject and its role in the game.
The prompt states the style, framing and background the purpose requires.
The prompt contains no text, logos, watermarks or real-world brands to render unless the purpose asks for them.
The prompt avoids contradictions (for example transparent background and a full scene).
The prompt describes silhouette and readability, not only surface detail.
image_rubric: The image shows the subject the prompt asked for, without extra subjects.
The style matches the style preset; no mixed rendering styles.
No unwanted text, watermark, signature or frame.
No anatomical, perspective or structural errors that block the target use.
The silhouette reads at thumbnail size.
